scenes.headline: How a 27B model decodes fast on one laptop GPU
scenes.sub: Per-layer megakernels and a speculative round that stays on the GPU
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Ingot! Here is how an open Metal engine runs a twenty-seven billion parameter model fast on one laptop.

scenes.text: Each layer's mixer runs as one kernel of persistent workers, and the whole draft-and-verify round stays on the GPU, so one pass over the weights yields several tokens.
scenes.mark: one pass over the weights yields several tokens
scenes.say: Each layer's mixer runs as one kernel, and the whole draft and verify round stays on the GPU.

parts.say: This chip moves about six hundred fourteen gigabytes a second.

parts.note: 17.6 GB of FP8 and NVFP4 weights
parts.say: One pass reads about seventeen and a half gigabytes. Plain decoding tops out near thirty four tokens a second.

steps.say: Eight token rows enter a layer. Eighty persistent workers claim the projection tiles.
After a barrier, each worker keeps a slice of the recurrent state in registers across all eight tokens.
Another barrier, then normalization and the output projection, in the same kernel.
The MLP stays as two ordinary kernels.

scenes.title: A round that never leaves the GPU

items.say: A small draft head proposes seven tokens, and a short chain corrects each one.
The big model checks all of them in one pass over its weights.
The GPU keeps the matching drafts, plus one bonus token.
Then the recorded round simply replays, with no CPU in the loop.

scenes.title: One recurrent layer, microseconds
scenes.say: Their own control is the surprise. Unfused kernels with the same tiles are just as fast. The win comes from layout and tiling.

scenes.label: the best published round, if all seven drafts are accepted
scenes.say: Their fastest round, with every draft accepted, gives about one hundred eighty eight a second. Their own prompts average about eighty.

scenes.text: Speculation sets the speed; fast layouts and a GPU-resident loop keep each round near the bus limit.
scenes.say: Speculation sets the speed. Fast layouts and a GPU resident loop keep each round near the bus limit.

recap: Plain decoding is capped by bandwidth
Each mixer is one persistent-worker kernel
Accepted drafts multiply tokens per pass
scenes.say: Bandwidth caps plain decoding. Each mixer is one kernel. Accepted drafts multiply the tokens per pass.
